contentHtml:
The 3-2 victory over England in the last encounter puts Spain in a good position in the Nations League, while coach Luis de la Fuente ponders Lamine Yamal's lineup for the match against the Czech Republic.

Decisive Victory Against England

In the last Nations League match, the Spanish national team defeated England 3-2, maintaining their unbeaten run in the group stage. The victory strengthened their position as group leaders and secured 9 points for the team.

Preparation for the Match Against the Czech Republic

With the match against the Czech Republic scheduled for Saturday, coach Luis de la Fuente is assessing Lamine Yamal's lineup, who has been a key element in recent victories.

Lamine Yamal: Electrifying Performance

  • Scored a goal in the victory against England.
  • Contributed two goals and an assist in the victory over Croatia.
  • The coach emphasized that, regardless of whether he starts or comes on as a substitute, Yamal is vital for the team.

Managing Physical Load This Season

De la Fuente highlighted that the international calendar is dense, leaving little time for recovery. He stated that he prioritizes player health, preferring to have a player in perfect condition.

Rotation and Selection Strategy

The coach assured that the team taking the field will be the most suitable for Saturday's match, leaving the final decision for the night before the game.

Upcoming Challenges in the Nations League

In addition to the match against the Czech Republic, Spain faces Croatia on October 6, concluding the current international window.

With information from BBC, Goal.com, VAVEL.com.
